Remember your Lord within yourself humbly and in fear, quietly, morning and evening; those near your Lord are not too arrogant to worship, exalt and prostrate to Him.
Allah knows the Prophet's breast is constrained by what they say; he is told to exalt his Lord with praise, prostrate, and worship until certainty comes.
Believers are told to remember Allah much and exalt Him morning and afternoon; He blesses them to bring them into light, and their greeting on meeting Him will be Peace.
